item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders that point the same way: check whether you're projecting, break old patterns, and ask if this moment supports the life you want. Those are good questions, but they only work when you stop and answer them. Reminders you swipe away change nothing. Pick one prompt today and answer it honestly, in one sentence, when it fires. Then act on that answer.
